title: Get additional interest categories by ID
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get additional interest categories by ID. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{22%}|v1.2{40%}|v1.3{38%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/tools/interest_keyword/get/|/v1.3/tool/interest_keyword/get/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string| |Request parameter name and data type|`id`: number| `keyword_id` : string| |New request parameters|/|`filtering`
`audience_type`| |Response parameter name and data type|`id`: number| `keyword_id`: string | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/interest_keyword/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162). | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {required}|string| Advertiser ID. | |keyword_query|object[]|Information of the additional interest category you want to get.
Max size = 50.| #|keyword_id {required}|string|Additional interest category ID.| #|language|string|Additional interest category language. Default value: `en`.
Supported languages: `fr`, `id`, `it`, `ja`, `ms`, `ar`, `vi`, `en`, `ru`, `es`, `th`, `tr`, `hi`, `zh`, `de`, `ko`.| |filtering| object |Filtering conditions.| #|audience_type| string|The audience type that you want to filter by. Enum values:
  • `GENERAL_INTEREST`: General interest. The audiences have a general, long-term interest in a video category.
  • `PURCHASE_INTENTION`: Purchase intent. The audiences' recent behavior suggests they may buy something related to a content category.
Default value: `GENERAL_INTEREST`.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code http curl) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/interest_keyword/get/?advertiser_id= {{ADVERTISER_ID}}&keyword_query=[{"keyword_id": "{{keyword_id}}"}]' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|The return code. For the complete list of error codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|The return message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id|string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| |data |object|Return data.| #|keywords|object[]| List of additional interest categories.| ##|keyword|string|Additional interest category.| ##|keyword_id|string| Additional interest category ID.| ##|status|string|Whether an additional interest category will be effective.
Enum values: `EFFECTIVE`, `INEFFECTIVE`.
An additional interest category is effective if using it can reach a reasonable number of people.
An additional interest category is ineffective if the projected audience size is too small.

Note: Only effective additional interest categories can be used in ad groups to target audiences.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "2021081206012901024503714416ABA90A", "data": { "keywords": [ { "keyword_id": "2027755677", "status": "EFFECTIVE", "keyword": "movie app" } ] } } (/code); ```
